progressions.serraFitNote: A globally proven minor-loop family that stays sensual and danceable rather than heavy. Useful for Serra when the lyric carries longing or desire but the body still needs forward motion.

chorusVariation.note: The independently corroborated chorus evidence supports the same core i–VI–III–VII loop. The verified lesson is not to invent a chord change: create chorus lift through melody, register, rhythm, groove, density or arrangement while preserving the harmonic hook.
